summary: EIP-8141 的内存池与 paymaster 部分集中推进：svlachakis 提交内存池生命周期定义，待处理身份为 `(sender, nonce)`，替换须两个费用字段都提价，所有付款方的待处理最大费用之和不得超过其余额；同时提交交易日志集合与回滚批次日志语义、规范 paymaster 的具体实现。AnkushinDaniil 提交签名方案注册表和按稳定身份识别规范 paymaster 两个 RFC。前一天提交的 blob 支持、直接求值验证前缀、APPROVE gas 成本和费用字段上限当天合并。zeam 宣布 EF 资助停止。

items.title: EIP-8141：定义公共内存池的替换、驱逐与付款方敞口
items.note: （svlachakis）提交。替换：待处理身份为 `(sender, nonce)`，签名或 witness 刷新的变体视为替换候选，从而消除签名可塑性造成的抖动；替换须独立有效，两个费用字段都按节点设定的最低幅度提价，可以更换付款方，预留随之原子转移。付款方敞口：规范 paymaster 的预留记账推广到所有付款方，待处理最大费用之和不超过付款方余额，防止一次余额变化让大量待处理交易同时失效。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: define replacement, eviction and payer exposure for the public mempool
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted. Replacement: pending identity is `(sender, nonce)`, and signature- or witness-refreshed variants are replacement candidates, which closes signature-malleability churn; replacements must be independently valid, bump both fee fields by a node-configured minimum, and may switch payer, with reservations moving atomically. Payer exposure: the canonical paymaster's reservation accounting generalizes to every payer, so summed pending maximum costs never exceed the payer's balance, preventing one balance change from invalidating many pending transactions at once.

items.title: EIP-8141：定义交易日志集合和回滚批次的日志语义
items.note: （svlachakis）提交：交易日志按 frame 顺序拼接，被展开的 frame 日志与其状态修改一并丢弃，否则两个客户端即使收据编码一致也可能在区块头 `logsBloom` 上分歧。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: define the transaction log set and unrolled-batch log semantics
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted: the transaction's logs are the frame receipts' logs in frame order, and an unrolled frame's logs are discarded with its state changes; otherwise two clients could agree on the receipt encoding and still disagree on the header `logsBloom`.

items.title: EIP-8141：规定规范 paymaster 的实现
items.note: （svlachakis）提交，用规范存储布局、付款授权、金库规则、管理接口和按分叉的 code hash 识别替换原来的占位描述。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: specify the canonical paymaster implementation
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted, replacing the placeholder with a normative storage layout, payment authorization, treasury rules, admin interface and per-fork code hash recognition.

items.title: 按稳定身份而非精确字节码识别规范 paymaster
items.note: AnkushinDaniil 提交两个 RFC：按稳定身份而非精确字节码识别规范 paymaster，即 EIP-7702 委托到保留地址或按分叉固定的 code hash；把签名方案表正式化为协议内注册表，签名方案是协议提供优化支持的密码学操作，而不是账户。
items.title_en: recognize the canonical paymaster by stable identity rather than exact bytecode match
items.note_en: AnkushinDaniil submitted two RFCs: recognize the canonical paymaster by stable identity rather than exact bytecode match, meaning an EIP-7702 delegation to a reserved address or a code hash pinned per fork, and formalize the signature scheme table as an in-protocol registry, where a signature scheme is a cryptographic operation the protocol supports in optimized form, not an account.

keywords_en: EIP-7906 state diff assertions listed as PFI
summary_en: EIP-8141's mempool and paymaster sections moved together: svlachakis submitted a mempool lifecycle definition where pending identity is `(sender, nonce)`, replacements must bump both fee fields, and summed pending maximum costs for any payer cannot exceed its balance; he also submitted the transaction log set and unrolled-batch log semantics, and a concrete canonical paymaster implementation. AnkushinDaniil submitted two RFCs, a signature scheme registry and recognizing the canonical paymaster by stable identity. Blob support, direct evaluation of validation prefixes, the APPROVE gas cost and fee field bounds, submitted the day before, merged. zeam announced its EF grant has ended.
